records.title: CryptoWeeklies Native Android App
records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 30 July 2026.

[2026-07-30_CRYPTO_APP]  
Video Title: CryptoWeeklies Native Android App  
Video ID: zhNNZkH7MIE  
CryptoWeeklies Native Android App (CRYPTO_APP) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure: Bitcoin is trading in a negative one standard deviation zone, indicating a market accumulation phase, while the S&P 500 sits above its mathematically derived fair value, suggesting a mild bullish expansion. The app flags AI in a shallow bear‑market territory and quantum computing in a bullish phase, both assessed via polynomial regression and volatility decay. Composite risk scores highlight a gravity risk of 16 for crypto, marking it as the second‑best DC window, and a low gravity risk for MSTR within a three‑standard‑deviation channel. Social sentiment is captured through a dynamic word‑cloud that updates in real time, reflecting heightened buzz around Bitcoin, ETH, and the top 20 crypto picks.  
    • Gravity risk 16 (crypto)  
    • Peak value index threshold 4,000  
    • TWAP baseline 200‑day SMA  

    Macro Quantitative Risk: TWAP baselines are anchored to the 200‑day moving average and all‑time‑high proximity, with Bitcoin’s TWAP risk flagged as elevated due to its negative one standard deviation position. Regression fair‑value bands are plotted as dotted white lines, with assets above the band considered overvalued and those below undervalued; the S&P 500 and Bitcoin both sit above their bands, while AI remains slightly above its fair value. Residual zones are identified by the app’s peak value index, which triggers alerts when it exceeds 4,000, signaling a potential shift into a new accumulation phase. The gravity risk metric, derived from time‑weighted average price deviations, shows crypto at 16
